title: AS$^2$D: Accelerating On-Demand Audio Understanding on Mobile Devices
abstract: arXiv:2609.37617v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Speculative decoding accelerates autoregressive generation by using a smaller drafter to propose tokens for batched verification by a larger target. However, conventional speculative decoding couples drafting to the target's evolving verified prefix, serializing drafting and verification. We ask whether this dependency is necessary for source-conditioned generation. Our key observation is that, for audio language models, the input audio and user request can provide useful speculative candidates without following the target's evolving text prefix. We propose AS$^2$D (Audio Speculative Speculative Decoding), which enables target-decoupled drafting: an audio-conditioned drafter follows its own generation history while the target independently verifies and corrects ready candidates. Without usable candidates, the target advances alone. Thus, target feedback determines which candidates are committed but no longer determines when the drafter

translated_title: AS$^2$D：加速移动设备上的按需音频理解
translated_abstract: 推测解码通过使用一个较小的起草模型为较大的目标模型提议词元并进行批量验证，从而加速自回归生成。然而，传统的推测解码将起草过程与目标模型不断演进的已验证前缀耦合在一起，导致起草和验证被串行化。我们探讨这种依赖关系对于源条件生成是否必要。我们的关键观察是：对于音频语言模型而言，输入音频和用户请求可以在不跟随目标模型不断演进的文本前缀的情况下提供有用的推测候选。我们提出AS$^2$D（Audio Speculative Speculative Decoding，音频推测解码），实现目标解耦的起草：由音频条件驱动的起草模型遵循自身的生成历史，而目标模型独立地验证并修正准备好的候选；在没有可用候选时，目标模型则独自推进。因此，目标模型的反馈只决定哪些候选被采纳，而不再决定起草模型何时进行生成。
tldr: 该论文提出AS$^2$D（音频推测解码），通过让音频条件驱动的起草模型摆脱对目标模型文本前缀的依赖、独立进行起草并由目标模型并行验证候选，从而解耦起草与验证过程，加速移动设备上的按需音频理解。
en_tdlr: The paper proposes AS$^2$D (Audio Speculative Speculative Decoding), which decouples drafting from the target model's evolving text prefix by letting an audio-conditioned drafter follow its own generation history while the target independently verifies ready candidates, accelerating on-demand audio understanding on mobile devices.
